harper (BillingOps): I spotted ~22 Stripe invoice webhooks that landed in our 'failed' queue but never created NetSuite invoices. Started ~2024-02-14T02:10Z after the idempotency-key change.

diego (Eng): confirmed. worker logs show 502 then a dedupe miss because format changed from `inv_<id>` to `stripe:inv:<id>`. Some retries were ignored.

maya (Finance): If those invoices didn't post AR will be understated. Can we replay safely?

diego (Eng): Yes, but we should normalize keys on replay and use external_id upserts. I'll run a dry replay for 3 sample ids: `./tools/replay --ids /tmp/sample_missing.txt --dry-run`.

alerts-bot: [INFO] 22 webhook events flagged for replay. See /playbooks/webhook-replay.

harper (BillingOps): share one dry-run payload so finance can sanity-check amounts.

diego (Eng): sample dry-run payload: `{external_id: "stripe_inv_5Yx", customer: "cus_12A", amount: 12500, currency: "USD", metadata: {source: "stripe"}}`

maya (Finance): sample OK. Proceed with full replay after you deploy a small migration to accept both key formats.

diego (Eng): patch deployed (accept both legacy and new idempotency formats) and replay running now (2024-02-14T02:45Z). Will report results.

harper (BillingOps): holding manual AR corrections until replay completes to avoid dupes.

diego (Eng): replay finished: 22 events reprocessed, 22 invoices created/upserted, no duplicate payments. Audit log: /replays/2024-02-14-webhook-replay.log

maya (Finance): spot-checked GLs and confirmed AR balance matches Stripe ledger for those customers. Good job.

harper (BillingOps): closing, and adding an alert for idempotency-format drift to avoid silent drops next time.
